'''Elric Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who betrayed the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] in favor of [[House of Thul]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Elric Organa betrayed [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and decided to join the Empire by serving as a spy for [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. However, Agent [[Tyuth]] learned of Elric's betrayal and tasked a Republic citizen to arrest him. Elric refused and tried to fight his way out until he was killed by the individual.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
